verdict.rationale: Workable exposes webhook subscriptions that notify external systems when candidate/job events occur, which enables event-driven automation, but there is no evidence of a native rules engine where users define conditions and in-app actions (e.g., 'if candidate reaches stage X, send email/reject') — actions must be built externally via API/webhook consumers. Missing for 10: in-product conditional rule builder, native automated actions (not just external notifications), and evidence of complex multi-condition triggers.
